title: About Us
summary: Since 2002, Throne Trading SARL has supplied certified safes, vault doors and security equipment to 50 banks and countless homes and businesses in Lebanon.
content:
THRONE TRADING SARL has been in the market for 22 years with a proven consistent record in working with 50 banks in Lebanon.
We Carry the Highest Security Level in the world for safes and vault doors UL Certified.
Our High Security safes is designed to withstand the most concentrated attacks by, Tool, Torch, Power drill, thermal lance and Explosives

We are proud to introduce our products:

► Drop Safes
► Filing Cabinets
► Fire & Burglary Resistance Safes
► High Security Safes
► Home & Office Safes
► Hotel Safes
► Safe Deposit Boxes
► Security Doors
► Vault Doors

Our brands are popular and famous for its strong, tough design, and our prices are economic compare to others.

Company Objective

  • To protect and secure customer/client money and valuables
  • It helps to secure the money and valuables when customer/client is not at home
  • To provide overall superior service and good value for money in every market segment in which we compete
  • To be good neighbor, concerned of the community needs and the environment
  • To deliver a strong and consistence financial performance

Company Mission

  • Our mission is to provide peace of mind through security integration.
  • We are here to exceed client's expectations through integrity and professionalism.
  • Our quality-driven team is committed to establishing long-term business relationships by providing exceptional service and comprehensive security solutions
